states.meaning: Method is in user scope; preconditions met or not required; no strong negative evidence. Enters generation as UNCONDITIONAL_KU_METHOD, still not a license to invent project facts.
states.mechanical_boundary: user_focus_match AND applicability_ok AND reuse_ok AND missing_preconditions_empty AND negative_evidence.strength!=strong

states.meaning: In-scope method whose enabling condition is unknown, empty in Brief, or listed in missing_information. Enters only with Knowledge Usage Contract must_conditionalize=true.
states.mechanical_boundary: in_scope AND (precondition in missing_information OR clarification empty OR non_applicable_conditions might apply)

states.meaning: Weak scenario/composition match or user-deprioritized domain. No dedicated chapter. Residual mention only if another in-scope process needs a stub.
states.mechanical_boundary: weak_positive_only OR user_deprioritized_domain AND not explicit_include

states.meaning: Negative constraint, applicability miss, reuse_scope block, guardrail-only, L0 historical fact/commitment, or provider-inferred false precondition.
states.mechanical_boundary: strong_negative OR reuse_mode in {do_not_reuse,evidence_only,structure_only as body} OR knowledge_type in {project_specific_fact,historical_commitment} with L0 OR guardrail membership

rules.name: UserNegativeOrDeprioritizedScope
rules.trigger: Brief.requirements or service_scope contains explicit negative / deprioritized language (除了…不用, 不负责, 不作为重点, 不含, 不开展).
rules.decision: Map hit domains to DEPRIORITIZED or EXCLUDED. 客服 except 宿舍 → EXCLUDE meeting-service KU; DEPRIORITIZE park-wide complaint/front-desk KU; ALLOW dormitory customer-service methods.

examples.brief: 客服除了宿舍管理之外基本上不用
examples.provider_reason: 办公楼会议服务需明确跨岗位责任边界

counter_examples.brief: 客服除宿舍外基本不用
counter_examples.expected: SELECTED or CONDITIONAL for 宿舍报事/入住协同 only

rules.name: ScenarioIsNotACatalog
rules.trigger: ku.scenario or content_role overlaps Brief.scenario (e.g. 前期介入) but KU is an adjacent specialty not named in requirements.
rules.decision: Scenario overlap is weak positive only. Do not SELECT 会议/培训/数字化/投诉 solely because scenario=前期介入.

examples.note: 前期介入 does not imply 会议服务

counter_examples.note: 前期介入+新建园区+审图方法
counter_examples.expected: CONDITIONAL until 是否含审图 is answered, not EXCLUDED

rules.name: FunctionalCompositionIsWeakEvidence
rules.trigger: Only match is a building type in functional_composition (有办公楼/有宿舍/有厂房).
rules.decision: Treat as weak positive_evidence. Cannot alone produce SELECTED for 会议服务, 石材专项, 礼宾, 一对一培训.

examples.expected: DEPRIORITIZED/EXCLUDED when 客服基本不用

counter_examples.positive_evidence: 一栋办公楼 plus 厂区清洁重点
counter_examples.expected: CONDITIONAL for 办公楼室内日常/专项分界 only, not whole-park

rules.name: ServiceScopeNegativeConstraints
rules.trigger: Explicit exclusion of work (不负责厂区车间设备维修).
rules.decision: EXCLUDED if KU would pull excluded objects into property scope. Workshop equipment KUs out. Engineering public-facility KUs remain.

examples.text: 不负责厂区车间设备维修
examples.expected: EXCLUDE any KU that treats 产线/工艺设备 as property O&M

counter_examples.expected: SELECTED/CONDITIONAL for 园区公区设施两层维保计划

rules.name: ApplicabilityMatch
rules.trigger: ku.applicability does not contain current project_type/scenario/medium objects.
rules.decision: If applicability is 办公物业投诉闭环 and project is 产业园 with 客服基本不用 → DEPRIORITIZED/EXCLUDED. If applicability is 多地块产业园安防 and project is 产业园 with 安防重点 → allow SELECTED method / CONDITIONAL commitments.

examples.applicability: 适用于办公物业投诉闭环

counter_examples.applicability: 多地块产业园分区分级安防

rules.name: NonApplicableConditions
rules.trigger: ku.non_applicable_conditions is likely true or unknown.
rules.decision: If condition is true → EXCLUDED. If unknown → CONDITIONAL, never SELECTED as unconditional. KU-9007 自营或强制采购时需改写 + 外包模式 missing → CONDITIONAL. KU-9008 客户不允许封闭管理 + 封闭管理空 → CONDITIONAL commitments.

examples.missing: 外包服务范围和管理模式

counter_examples.expected: SELECTED method, still no invented SLA

rules.name: ReuseScopeAndReuseMode
rules.trigger: reuse_scope is same_project_only / same_client_or_company_only, or reuse_mode is do_not_reuse / evidence_only / structure_only.
rules.decision: Never SELECT as positive body seed. Guardrail membership → active_guardrail only.

examples.expected: EXCLUDED from positive pack, remain guardrail

rules.name: KnowledgeTypeAndAbstraction
rules.trigger: knowledge_type in {project_specific_fact, historical_commitment, data_fact, company_specific_policy} or abstraction_level=L0_original_fact.
rules.decision: L0 facts/commitments/data are EXCLUDED from positive pack. L1/L2 methods may SELECT/CONDITIONAL. L3 still cannot mint project numbers.

counter_examples.expected: CONDITIONAL method; 资料禁看 stays additional control

rules.name: MissingInformationIsPrecondition
rules.trigger: A KU enabling fact is exactly a missing_information item and clarification_answers[item] is empty.
rules.decision: Force CONDITIONAL, never fully applicable. Provider text such as 大概率外包 is PROVIDER_INFERENCE and is not a filled clarification.

examples.same_run_missing: 外包服务范围和管理模式

rules.name: EvidenceBalance
rules.trigger: Both positive and negative evidence exist.
rules.decision: strong_negative > weak_positive. 办公楼 is weak; 客服基本不用 is strong. Output DEPRIORITIZED/EXCLUDED and keep both evidence lists for audit.

examples.negative: 客服除宿舍外基本不用

rules.name: ProviderMustNotFillUnknownConditions
rules.trigger: Provider selection reason asserts an unconfirmed operating fact (大概率外包, 通常封闭, 一般有会议).
rules.decision: Strip inferred fact. Re-score KU. Add selection_reason=provider_inference_removed.

examples.provider_reason: 厂区清洁、危化品区域消杀等环境作业大概率外包
examples.expected: do not treat outsourcing as PROJECT_FACT

counter_examples.provider_reason: 若走外包可用台账考核；现在还不知道是否外包
counter_examples.expected: allow CONDITIONAL, this is correct restraint

rules.name: StyleCompletenessCannotOverrideNegativeScope
rules.trigger: Writing-style M-010/D-003/C-003 would add 投诉/会议/礼宾 chapters the user deprioritized.
rules.decision: User negative scope beats default catalogue completeness. Residual 报事 may be a CONDITIONAL_METHOD under 宿舍/工程, not a 客服团队 chapter. C-003 already forbids boosting 会务 unless bank/finance/HQ or explicit need.

examples.qwen_reason: 园区客服虽非重点但仍需投诉闭环
examples.expected: DEPRIORITIZED; no 客服团队统一受理

counter_examples.note: user asks for 客户服务与投诉专章

rules.name: CandidateMembershipSplit
rules.decision: Positive pack ∩ guardrail pack = empty. Guardrails activate CG fingerprints only.

examples.expected: guardrail because 客服基本不用 and 礼宾制度

rules.name: UserFocusWeight
rules.trigger: Brief.requirements names focus domains (安防, 人员车辆, 厂房, 厂区清洁, 危化品, 宿舍).
rules.decision: Boost matching L1/L2 methods toward SELECTED/CONDITIONAL. Non-focus specialties default DEPRIORITIZED unless required by law or named.

counter_examples.note: commercial HQ brief that names 会议接待

rules.name: ProjectTypeMismatch
rules.trigger: ku.project_type does not include current brief.project_type and no explicit user ask.
rules.decision: DEPRIORITIZE 商业写字楼/金融办公 KUs on 产业园区 unless user names that service.

non_goals: new B1.2 fields in this round
